review_description: This company has been around for a long time, quality panels and inverter helped make my decision

The panels are 16 x  BP 170watt  with a SMA inverter that can expand for 8 more panels. Cost effective or not I cannot say until we get the next power bill. Quality and installation is o.k. I have been doing a rough check on the output and because we do experience quite a lot of hours of sunshine, I think that it will possibly break even.  When I know better after I get a power bill I can inform you then if you wish.Trevor

Local Company, New their Products well, No Hard sell. No deposit required, Payment in full once installation completed and I as a customer happy.Excellent warranty on all components.Been in business for twenty years. Products used Excellent,  very good quality. Pricing in the range I expected.Other Suppliers, not even close to the warranty and services provided by Cairns Solar,Another very important issue have own local Staff for all work.

I believe that by using the BP solar panels I have a very top of the range system and my solar supplier bettered all other deals, and came through for me on an early instalation, what more could one ask for.
